It is a cross between Martian Mean Green, known for its stimulating effects and fruity flavors, and Wedding Cake, loved for its relaxing effects and sweet, vanilla-like taste. With this combo, you’re looking at a nice blend of cerebral high and relaxing effects. Space Junky usually has a sweet, fruity aroma, kind of like berries with a hint of citrus. When you smoke it, you'll get a taste that matches that—think blueberries with a bit of earthy undertones. The high kicks in with a euphoric, uplifting vibe, which is great if you want to chill but still stay engaged and creative. In terms of effects, it’s known for giving you a balanced high—initially, it’ll get your head buzzing and uplifted, but it doesn’t leave you couch-locked. As the high progresses, you might feel more relaxed and mellow, which makes it a good choice for both day and evening use. Overall, if you're looking for something that hits that sweet spot between relaxation and energy, Space Junky is definitely worth checking out. Limonene- This terpene gives off a citrusy, lemony smell. Limonene is known for its uplifting and mood-enhancing effects. This terpene is believed to have memory-enhancing and anti-inflammatory properties. It also balances out the high, providing a bit of mental clarity and focus.
